title: Galaxy phone is slow or lagging
content:
Smartphone,Tablet Galaxy phone is slow or lagging: ## Troubleshooting Slow Performance
If your device has become sluggish, work through these steps in order.
### Step 1: Free Up Storage
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap Battery and device care.
Tap Storage to review what is consuming space.
### Step 2: Limit Background Activities
Go to Settings, tap Apps, and then tap Background activities to see what is running.
Restrict apps you do not use frequently.
### Step 3: Schedule a Restart
Go to Settings and tap Restart on schedule to reboot the device automatically.
### Step 4: Close Unused Applications
Tap the Recents icon and close applications you are not using.
### Step 5: Restart in Safe Mode
Press and hold the Power button and the Volume down button at the same time.
Touch and hold Power off, then tap Safe mode.
Safe mode helps identify whether a third-party app is causing the slowdown.
### Step 6: Factory Data Reset
Back up your data before proceeding with this step.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap General management.
Tap Reset.
Tap Factory data reset.
Tap Delete all.
